newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling in j/v with Ford unit.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling in j/v with Ford unit.

text.p: Jiangling Motors Corp Ltd has signed a letter of intent with Lear Corp, a unit of Ford Motor Co, to set up a venture to produce car and light truck interior facilities, the official Securities Times said on Thursday.

The letter of intent on the venture was signed between Jiangling and Lear in Detroit last month and the two will sign a formal agreement in Nanchang, capital of southeastern China's Jiangxi province, in November, it said.
The venture will have a registered capital of $14.60 million, with Jiangling and Lear each holding a 50 percent stake, it said.

Xiong Zhongping, a spokesman for Jiangling, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin the venture, Lear Interior Decoration System Co, would make seats and air-conditioners for cars and light trucks.
Xiong said Jiangling, based in Jiangxi province, would in the near future establish a "sister relationship" with Cleveland Engine & Casting Plants, another Ford subsidiary.
Jiangling's cooperation with Ford dates back to 1995 when Ford paid about US$40 million to purchase 80 percent of Jiangling's issue of 174 million class B shares.

At that time, Jiangling said it had a total share capital of 693.214 million shares, comprising 353.240 million state shares, 174.000 million B shares, 117.600 million A shares and 48.374 million legal person shares.
